issues.on_page: Grants and donations 220 (General), 2,733 (Library), 500 (Cemetery), printed under Other financing sources (uses)
issues.issue: Grants and donations are revenue, not transfers, debt proceeds or sale of assets. The extraction itself records the same 3,453 as a donations/contributions receipt (receipts[11], outside_printed_total). These three detail lines (detail[106], [107], [108]) should be section 'revenue', category 'donations/contributions', detail_category 'donations/contributions', with outside_printed_total: true. As entered they drop out of revenue detail and are treated like financing.

With 21,811, both the General column (sum 580,850 vs printed 580,849) and the Interest row (21,811+1,763+840+108 = 24,522 vs printed 24,521) are off by 1. A value of 21,810 would make both tie, so this digit may be misread, or the report rounds. report_discrepancies mentions only the column difference, not the Interest row.

The category rules put cemetery under health/welfare. The extractor used public safety to tie to the statement's Public safety line (142,029 = Police 118,399 + Cemetery 23,630) and marked review. This applies to all Cemetery expenditure lines, detail[95]-[101].

63,653 of the 66,972 'Other miscellaneous' receipts sits in the TIF column, which is most likely tax-increment (property tax) money passed through. Left as other/miscellaneous with review; a person should confirm. The same applies to receipts[10].
